stem: A BI team is assembling a visualization pipeline for data that starts as raw CSV files in S3, and needs one service to catalog the files' schema and a separate service QuickSight can connect to as its data source. Which TWO services fit these two needs respectively? (Select TWO.)

choices.text: An Amazon S3 access point for the schema cataloging
An AWS Glue crawler for the schema cataloging
Amazon EMR Serverless for the QuickSight data source
Amazon Athena for the QuickSight data source
AWS Lake Formation for the QuickSight data source

rationale: A Glue crawler scans the raw CSV files and writes their schema into the Data Catalog, and QuickSight connects to Athena as its data source to query cataloged S3 tables for a dashboard. An S3 access point only scopes network and permission access to a bucket; it does not scan files or discover their schema. EMR Serverless runs Spark or Hive processing jobs; it is not a data source QuickSight connects to directly. Lake Formation manages permissions on the catalog, it is not itself a queryable data source that QuickSight connects to.
